name: COCO-Text: Text Detection and Recognition in Natural Images
description: COCO-Text (v2.0) is a large-scale scene text detection and recognition benchmark built upon the Microsoft Common Objects in Context (MS COCO) dataset. Curated by researchers from Cornell Tech and Czech Technical University in Prague, COCO-Text contains 63,686 natural images from the MS COCO 2014 training split, annotated with 239,506 text instances. Each text region is annotated with word bounding polygons, legibility flags, script types, text category (machine printed or handwritten), and fine-grained character transcriptions. As text in MS COCO appears incidentally rather than prominently centered, COCO-Text serves as an unconstrained benchmark for text detection in natural scenes.
